"""
	Populate dropdown with supervisor full names (firstName + lastName).
	
	Args:
		None (onStartup event)
	
	Returns:
		None (writes to self.custom.supervisorOption)
	"""
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("dautom.views.supervisorDropdown")
	
	try:
		# Input variables (for Script Console debugging)
		# userSource = "ClariosAD"  # Replace with actual user source for testing
		
		# Configuration
		targetRole = "Supervisor_PAPO"
		userSource = self.session.custom.userSource
		
		# Get all users from user source
		allUsers = system.user.getUsers(userSource)
		
		# print "Total users found: {}".format(len(allUsers))
		# logger.info("Starting supervisor dropdown population - Total users: {}".format(len(allUsers)))
		
		# Filter users with Supervisor_PAPO role
		supervisorList = []
		
		for user in allUsers:
			# Get username
			username = user.get("Username")
			
			# Get user roles using getRoles() method
			userRoles = user.getRoles()
			
			# print "User: {} - Roles: {}".format(username, list(userRoles))
			
			# Check if user has target role
			if targetRole in userRoles:
				# Get firstName and lastName
				firstName = user.get("FirstName")
				lastName = user.get("LastName")
				
				# Concatenate full name
				if firstName and lastName:
					fullName = "{} {}".format(firstName, lastName)
				elif firstName:
					fullName = firstName
				elif lastName:
					fullName = lastName
				else:
					fullName = username  # Fallback to username if no name defined
				
				supervisorList.append(fullName)
				# print "Added supervisor: {} ({})".format(fullName, username)
		
		# Sort alphabetically for better UX
		supervisorList.sort()
		
		# Write to custom property for dropdown consumption
		self.custom.supervisorOption = supervisorList
		
		# print "Supervisor dropdown populated - Total supervisors: {}".format(len(supervisorList))
		# logger.info("Supervisor dropdown populated successfully - Total: {} - List: {}".format(len(supervisorList), supervisorList))
	
	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error populating supervisor dropdown: " + str(e))
		self.custom.supervisorOption = []

"""
	Save form data to database including supervisor selection.
	
	Collects answers from all FlexContainerGroups and appends supervisor
	answer from FlexContainerSupervisor into the same JSON before INSERT.
	
	Args:
		self (Component): Reference to root component
		payload (dict): Message payload (unused)
	
	Returns:
		None: Performs database INSERT and sends UI refresh messages
	"""
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("clarios/puestaPuntos/saveDataRoot")
	
	try:
		from java.lang import String
		
		# ---- Context ----
		papoID = self.view.params.papoID
		
		# Get user full name (firstName + lastName) or fallback to userName
		userName = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
		firstName = self.session.props.auth.user.get("firstName", "")
		lastName = self.session.props.auth.user.get("lastName", "")
		user = "{} {}".format(firstName, lastName).strip() if firstName or lastName else userName
		
		workstationNodeID = self.view.params.workstationnodeID
		workstationID = self.view.params.workstationID
		nodeID = self.view.params.nodeID
		status = "En proceso"
		now = system.date.now()
		
		flexGroupCount = int(self.custom.flexGroupCount)
		
		# logger.info("User full name: {}".format(user))
		
		# ---- Get last RegisterCode ----
		queryLastCode = """
			SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
			FROM registerhistory
			WHERE WorkstationNodeID = ? AND PapoID = ?
			ORDER BY ID DESC
		"""
		rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(queryLastCode, [workstationNodeID, papoID], "papo_db")
		lastCode = rs.getValueAt(0, 0) if rs.getRowCount() > 0 else 0
		regCode = int(lastCode)
		
		# ---- Insert template ----
		insertSql = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		"""
		
		def _inferRegisterType(answersObj):
			"""Extract registerTypeID from first item in answers."""
			items = answersObj.get("items", []) if answersObj else []
			if items and isinstance(items[0], dict) and "registerTypeID" in items[0]:
				return int(items[0]["registerTypeID"])
			return 7
		
		# ---- Get supervisor answer from FlexContainerSupervisor ----
		supervisorContainer = self.getChild("FlexContainerSupervisor")
		supervisorItem = None
		
		if supervisorContainer is not None:
			supervisorAnswers = self.answerRecopile(supervisorContainer)
			logger.debug("Supervisor answers: {}".format(supervisorAnswers))
			
			if supervisorAnswers is not None:
				supervisorItems = supervisorAnswers.get("items", [])
				if supervisorItems:
					supervisorItem = dict(supervisorItems[0])
					logger.debug("Supervisor item captured: " + str(supervisorItem))
				else:
					logger.warn("Supervisor answers has no items")
			else:
				logger.warn("Supervisor answerRecopile returned None")
		else:
			logger.warn("FlexContainerSupervisor not found")
		
		# ---- Process each FlexContainerGroup ----
		for groupIndex in range(1, flexGroupCount + 1):
			flexGroup = self.getChild("FlexContainerGroup{}".format(groupIndex))
			
			# Collect answers from this group
			answersObj = self.answerRecopile(flexGroup)
			logger.debug("Raw answers group {}: {}".format(groupIndex, answersObj))
			
			# Skip if empty
			items = answersObj.get("items", []) if answersObj else []
			if not items:
				logger.warn("Group {} has no items - skipping".format(groupIndex))
				continue
			
			# ---- CRITICAL: Clean items - remove any metadata items that came from answerRecopile ----
			cleanedItems = []
			for item in items:
				if isinstance(item, dict):
					# Keep only items with papoItemID (actual answers)
					if "papoItemID" in item:
						cleanedItems.append(item)
			
			answersObj["items"] = cleanedItems
			logger.debug("Cleaned items group {}: {} items".format(groupIndex, len(cleanedItems)))
			
			# ---- Append supervisor to first group (BEFORE final metadata) ----
			if groupIndex == 1 and supervisorItem is not None:
				answersObj["items"].append(supervisorItem)
				logger.info("Supervisor appended to FlexContainerGroup1")
			
			# ---- CRITICAL: Always append final metadata as LAST item ----
			finalMetadata = {
				"insights": "",
				"registerTypeID": 7,
				"user": user,
				"timestamp": str(now)
			}
			answersObj["items"].append(finalMetadata)
			logger.info("Final metadata appended as last item - user: {}".format(user))
			
			registerTypeID = _inferRegisterType(answersObj)
			dataAnswerStr = String(system.util.jsonEncode(answersObj))
			
			logger.debug("Encoded JSON group {}: {}".format(groupIndex, dataAnswerStr))
			
			params = [
				now,
				dataAnswerStr,
				status,
				papoID,
				registerTypeID,
				user,
				workstationNodeID,
				nodeID,
				workstationID,
				regCode
			]
			
			system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertSql, params, "papo_db")
			logger.info("Record saved - PapoID: {} RegisterCode: {} Group: {}".format(papoID, regCode, groupIndex))
		
		# ---- UI refresh ----
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTable", {"estado": True}, scope="session")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("closeEmbeded", {"estado": False}, scope="session")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPeriodic", {"min": 0}, scope="session")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPreviewTable", payload=[], scope="session")
		
	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error saving form data: " + str(e))
